kuzhine e vecuar

title_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale in the Delijorgji complex, in the Sinani buildings
description_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale in the Delijorgji complex, in the Sinani buildings. The apartment has a surface of 125m2. It is organized in: separate kitchen, living room, 2 bedrooms, 2 toilets, storage room, balcony. It is located on the 5th floor, building with elevator. Suitable for residence and investment. This apartment was invested in the last 2 years and was made with quality investment. Inhabited only by the owners. Easy access to the main road, urban transport, schools, markets and other services. It has certificates of ownership! There is also a parking post at an extra cost.
